author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Filipino culture as it pertains to the indigenous language is highly aural-oral. It's not just Tagalog, as there are regional and local languages, as well. English as fizzy faddish words is part of the common code-switching of the masses, whilst Spanish loanwords sit in feeling at home in the stew. It's a linguistic hodgepodge. Most just enjoy long hours of chitchat or watching television, videos, or cinema commonly in the indigenous language. English sounds and text don't really appeal to the masses, but English is a hesitantly established piece of furniture, useful for understanding the outside world. Filipinos generally are not known as avid readers, except for elite people maybe entrenched in the margins of the Anglosphere. Literature in the indigenous language is still relatively scarce.

text: 菲律賓文化同土著語言有關，係高度聽覺嘅。唔單止係塔加洛文，因為有地區同本地語言。英文作為氣泡時尚嘅詞語，係群眾常見嘅轉碼嘅一部分，而西班牙語嘅借詞就係喺燉菜入面感覺好似喺屋企噉。呢個係一個語言學嘅大集繪。大部分人只係鍾意長時間傾偈，或者用土著語言睇電視、影片或者電影。英文嘅聲音同文字唔係好吸引到大眾，但英文係一件猶豫不決地建立嘅傢俬，對理解外界有用。菲律賓人一般都唔係好鍾意讀書，除咗可能根深蒂固喺英國圈邊緣嘅精英人士。土著語言嘅文學仍然相對稀少啲。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It's the 18th of May of 2025. Even though there's still much of Minda's delicious macaroni in the fridge, after 17:00, I went out to Tim Hortons café to enjoy an Iced Classic Lemonade and a Turkey Bacon Club Artisan Sandwich. The sun rays bathed the hall. I was thinking that even with higher nonhuman intelligence in the plausible future, humans could still evolve in tandem, like cats and dogs with their masters. Transhumanism might become a prevalent reality.

jyutping: ji4 gaa1 hai6 2025 nin4 5 jyut6 18 hou6。seoi1 jin4 syut3 gwai6 jap6 min6 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 ming4 daat6 ge3 hou2 mei6 tung1 sam1 fan2，daan6 hai6 hai2 17 dim2 zi1 hau6，ngo5 zau6 ceot1 heoi3 Tim Hortons café sik6 zo2 bui1 bing1 ging1 din2 ning4 mung1 seoi2 tung4 fo2 gai1 jin1 juk6 keoi1 lok6 bou6 sau2 gung1 saam1 man4 zi6。taai3 joeng4 gwong1 sin3 cung1 loeng4 zo2 go3 daai6 tong4。ngo5 nam2 gan2，zau6 syun3 hai2 mei6 loi4 jau5 gang3 gou1 ge3 fei1 jan4 leoi6 zi3 lik6，jan4 leoi6 jing4 jin4 ho2 ji5 bing6 gin1 zeon3 faa3，zau6 hou2 ci5 maau1 gau2 tung4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 zyu2 jan4 jat1 joeng6。kwaa3 jan4 leoi6 zyu2 ji6 ho2 nang4 wui5 sing4 wai4 jat1 go3 pou2 pin3 ge3 jin6 sat6。
text: 而家係2025年5月18號。雖然雪櫃入面仲有好多明達嘅好味通心粉，但係喺17點之後，我就出去 Tim Hortons café 食咗杯冰經典檸檬水同火雞煙肉俱樂部手工三文治。太陽光線沖涼咗個大堂。我諗緊，就算喺未來有更高嘅非人類智力，人類仍然可以並肩進化，就好似貓狗同佢哋嘅主人一樣。跨人類主義可能會成為一個普遍嘅現實。
